trust_decision.summary: Subtitle text from external WebVTT/DFXP files, and any HTML string handed to the core DOM helpers, is untrusted and must be sanitized before it is inserted as HTML; the decision is implemented by the new sanitizeHtml in src/js/core/dom.js and applied at the caption render sink and inside createElement/createElementWithHtmlText.

landing_point.why: An engineer reading only 'stored XSS via caption cue text' looks at the one place where cue text is written to the page: the TIMEUPDATE/SEEK handler appends each cue.captions entry to this._captionsContainer.innerHTML.

fix_sites.entry_point: player.captionsCanvas (enableCaptions + TIMEUPDATE/SEEK events render the active cue)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The shared DOM helpers only build trusted player chrome (buttons, icons, popups) and the advisory names subtitle files, so a solver can argue the caption sink alone is the affected code and leave core/dom.js untouched.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: HTML formatting inside captions must keep rendering: doc/captions.md:49 states 'You can use HTML tags in the captions' (example <strong> at doc/captions.md:27), the WebVTT fixture uses <b> at repository_test/repository/webvtt-captions/captions.es.vtt:4 and DFXP cues carry <span ...> markup (repository_test/repository/dfxp-captions/captions.dfxp:17). At the same time createElementWithHtmlText builds every button/icon/menu from HTML template strings (e.g. src/js/core/ButtonPlugin.js:49, src/js/core/MenuButtonPlugin.js:88), so escaping or stripping all tags breaks captions and the whole UI, and an empty result makes dom.js:20 return undefined.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: plugin-supplied icon and title HTML written straight to iconElement/_titleContainer.innerHTML, bypassing the sanitized helpers
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Icons and titles are HTML/SVG strings from plugin code and plugin config in the same module family as the sanitized helpers; a maintainer hardening DOM insertion would plausibly route them through sanitizeHtml too.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: skin JSON 'icon' values are inserted with div.innerHTML in checkLoadSkinIcons/loadSkinIcons
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Skin data is loaded from a remote JSON URL (src/js/core/Skin.js:81-88), so it is the same external-data-to-innerHTML mechanism and a natural place to add the new sanitizer.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: createElement sets attributes directly with setAttribute, so href/src/javascript: URLs and on* handlers are not filtered even though the sibling HTML-string path now filters them
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The fix hardened only the children/htmlText arguments of the same function; a maintainer writing a URL-attribute allowlist would naturally extend it to the attributes loop.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: popup title from player.translate(titleData) inserted with titleBarContent.innerHTML
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Popup titles are plugin/i18n supplied strings rendered as HTML right next to the newly sanitized UI helpers.

O9_family: CWE-79 cross-site scripting (stored HTML injection into caption/DOM rendering)

O10_build.language: JavaScript (ES modules with Babel; CSS/SVG imported through webpack loaders)
O10_build.toolchain: Node.js 20 + npm ci; webpack 5 with @babel/preset-env and babel-loader; eslint; @playwright/test for e2e (package.json:7-13, .github/workflows/playwright.yml:12-21)
O10_build.project_tests: Playwright e2e in tests/*.spec.js against `npm run testenv` (webpack dev server on port 8000, playwright.config.js:107-112). The captions area is covered by tests/trimming.spec.js:28-40 ('Captions in trimmed video'), which enables captions from repository_test/repository/webvtt-captions and asserts the cue text 'es un enfoque' is visible. There are no unit tests for the parsers or for dom.js, and the fix adds no tests. Caption files used by the fixtures are local (repository_test/repository/webvtt-captions/captions.es.vtt, repository_test/repository/dfxp-captions/captions.dfxp); the media URLs in those manifests are remote but are not needed to parse or render cue text.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Sanitize only at the caption sink (e.g. set _captionsContainer.innerText or strip tags from cue.captions) and stop there, which breaks documented <b>/<span> caption formatting and leaves core/dom.js, the DFXP text setter and the WebVTT parser untouched.
